# embedded-cli

Vendored single-header CLI by Sviatoslav Kokurin (`funbiscuit/embedded-cli`),
distributed under the MIT license retained in `embedded_cli.h`. This is the
header snapshot shipped with TinyUSB 0.21.0 at
`lib/embedded-cli/embedded_cli.h`; it is copied here so builds do not depend on
an SDK-side include path. SHA-256:

```
e89c8b219f78d7d6b2a55558c1004316f56ded76690f7a68285b5f5160b4a2e3  embedded_cli.h
```
